before.name: Faye Brown
before.description: 22-year-old Black woman on North Carolina's death row for the alleged killing of a state trooper, condemned along with her co-defendants though only one shot was fired; The Black Panther Vol. 15 no.4 (1976) presents her as unjustly sentenced to death.
before.body:
Custody research — September 2026

The corrections profile confirms state-prison admission on July 8, 1977 for the Martin County case. Earlier pretrial custody and actual release remain unresolved.

  • North Carolina Department of Correction, 2009 inmate profiles, Faye B. Brown #0049355

Birth year source: Contemporary or biographical report documenting Faye Brown's age.

credit: Faye Brown portrait via NC Coalition for Alternatives to the Death Penalty, May 13, 2020. Photographer unspecified.
rights: No open license or public-domain status stated; rights holder unspecified. Public accessibility does not establish public-domain status.
identity_verification: Caption explicitly names Faye Brown. Article identifies age22 in1975, Martin County bank robbery, Trooper Guy Thomas Davis Jr, death sentence commuted to life and 45years custody; matches profile. Mourning Our Losses and Benevolence Farm memorial corroborate.
crop: Original 200x200 publisher portrait preserved without upscaling or facial alteration. Small and somewhat soft but recognizable; better-resolution source remains desirable.
